entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: West to northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Note: Westerly winds may approach severe gale again during Friday afternoon. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Watch period extended.

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers may affect the road from early Friday morning and 2 to 4 cm may accumulate about the summit, and lesser amounts down to 800 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers will affect the road until Friday afternoon, but snow is only expected to accumulate on the road overnight tonight into early Friday morning. 1 cm may accumulate between midnight tonight and 5am Friday morning above 700 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers may affect the road at times until Friday evening, but snow is not expected to accumulate on the road until Friday morning. Up to 1 cm may accumulate between 6 am and noon Friday, with lesser amounts down to 700 metres.
